question: What are the Free mode requests per second, tokens per minute and tokens per month shown at admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits, and does Studio ask an email sign-up for a phone number before an API key works?
why: both values are behind a sign-up: the Limits page redirects to the sign-in flow, and the registration form has no phone field, so only an account shows whether a later phone prompt exists; the operator's account step (rq:operator) settles both
